benchmark_evidence.observed: Scheduling can optimize for availability or equal distribution, respecting connected calendars.

capabilities.foundly_current: Recorded availability produces bookable slots, distribution favors calendars with fewer recorded appointments in the requested period, stale selections are rejected, and private in-app reminders survive restart. HTTP booking and UI forms are implemented. Reminder execution now binds to the current authorized planner, preserving explicit recipient delegation. Revoked/suspended planners cannot borrow worker rights; isolated commits and rotating bounded batches preserve unrelated work and restart idempotency.
capabilities.gap: External-calendar reconciliation and actual browser acceptance remain unproven.
capabilities.required_change: Validate real calendar reconciliation with authorized provider access and complete browser interaction acceptance.
capabilities.foundly_differentiator: Candidate: shared Core identity, provenance and ZERO tools. Comparative superiority is not proven.
